children: Telomir reports Telomir-Zn shows dose-dependent growth inhibition in human and canine osteosarcoma cell lines.
Ohio State study: Telomir-Zn inhibited cell growth in HOS (human), D17 and Abrams (canine) osteosarcoma lines.
All three cell lines showed growth inhibition at similar low drug concentrations, supporting translational potential.
Company advancing TNBC Phase 1/2 program toward site initiation and patient enrollment under an active FDA-cleared IND.
Telomir is discussing a potential in vivo efficacy study in canine osteosarcoma to support veterinary indication and human relevance.
Parallel canine pathway could accelerate translational insight while the TNBC program progresses clinically.
